title: Voucher profile – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This page explains the voluntary Voucher profile feature in a MyServiceNSW Account, which helps check a child's eligibility for available vouchers.
intro:
The Voucher profile is a voluntary feature in a MyServiceNSW Account.

Once a Voucher profile is created it can be used to help check a child’s eligibility for any vouchers that are made available through a MyServiceNSW Account.
what_you_need: Medicare card details (card number, individual reference number, full name, and card type)
Name of the educational institution the child/ren are enrolled in for 2023 or beyond
